Step 9 pathway closure for `phase-2-remaining-27` is complete.

## What changed

**`library/foundations/_pathway.md` — `## ordinals-and-cardinals`** (rewritten, 119 words)
Retains the ordinal/cofinality/weak-choice core, clubs–stationarity–trees–Diamond, determinacy, PCF/Dowker, completeness/incompleteness, reflection, BPI/Stone duality/Halpern–Läuchli, the large-cardinal, inner-model, forcing, symmetric-extension and permutation-model strands; now covers the three gained pages: Baire calibration (complete-metric Baire exactly DC, compact-Hausdorff Baire exactly DMC, Urysohn's lemma from DMC but not CC or BPI, Stone's metrization failing consistently under DC and BPI), NMSC proved under PMEA and refuted by $V=L$ with its measurable↔strongly-compact strength sandwich, and Shelah's ZF+DC Baire-property model (equiconsistent with ZFC) against universal measurability at an inaccessible.

**`library/functional-analysis/_pathway.md` — `## foundations`** (rewritten, 119 words)
Retains the normed-space/completeness spine, Fourier and tempered-distribution block, Hahn–Banach separation/norming, weak/weak-star/locally-convex duality, Banach–Alaoglu–Goldstine–Krein–Milman, reflexivity–Eberlein–Šmulian–James, Schauder bases/approximation, Bochner integration/RND; now covers all eleven gained pages (Hilbert geometry and Riesz representation; orthonormal bases, Parseval, Fourier series; compact operators, Riesz–Schauder, Fredholm index; Banach algebras and holomorphic calculus; Gelfand theory for commutative C*-algebras; continuous, Borel, spectral-measure and unbounded calculi; compact self-adjoint spectral theorem with Hilbert–Schmidt kernels and trace class; Fréchet calculus on Banach manifolds; Stone's theorem).

Frontmatter, both part slugs, and every page order are untouched (my edits are body-only; the frontmatter page insertions in the diff came from the engine's `9-pathway-sync-v2`).

**`research/phase-2-remaining-27-pathway-closure.json`** — both rows closed in place, no rows added/removed/merged: `status:"closed"`, `reviewer:"Lead Alpha"`, `disposition:"rewritten"`, a mathematical rationale naming the retained strands and the gained results, and the current section hash.
